name: tamaclaw
description: Companion display for OpenClaw: an animated mascot that speaks, emotes, and shows notifications and dashboards on a small screen. OpenClaw plugin + bridge + display in one package.

scripts.shell:build: mkdir -p dist/Tamaclaw.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc -O shell/TamaclawShell.swift -o dist/Tamaclaw.app/Contents/MacOS/Tamaclaw && cp shell/Info.plist dist/Tamaclaw.app/Contents/Info.plist && (codesign --force --sign - dist/Tamaclaw.app 2>/dev/null || true) && echo '→ dist/Tamaclaw.app'
